selection: regenerate and verify the prior annotation-only plan before reading private captures; no reselection
input_denominator: all 15 ARTBeaT and 25 RUBATO cases; private captures read only for seven selected ARTBeaT tracks
reuse: unchanged whole-capture packet provenance, prefix clocks, half-open crop and rational one-to-one ledger; no window-local re-extraction
pair_eligibility: both windows, both sources and every clock must satisfy prefix, annotation coverage, response/tick budgets and packet support; any rejection excludes the entire pair from ledger comparisons, never replaces it
boundary: retain incomplete query labels and never count boundary-censored ticks as interior misses
metrics: per source/context/clock matched responses, unmatched ticks and responses, all-optimal assignment ambiguity, annotated miss causes, candidate sign strata and off-annotation response strata
contrasts: annotated and both half phases and double each versus continuation: matched delta and unmatched-tick delta separately; per-track constant/change relation cross-tab, never a weighted score
relations: left_dominates if matched>= and unmatched_ticks<= with one strict; right_dominates conversely; equal if both equal; otherwise tradeoff; descriptive accounting, not a selected tempo
